          {
            "text": "## 💡 教訓",
            "lineNumber": 680
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 681
          },
          {
            "text": "### うまくいったこと",
            "lineNumber": 682
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 683
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **モジュール分離**: blueprint, telemetry, webhooksを完全分離 → テスト・保守が容易",
            "lineNumber": 684
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Type-safe State Machine**: Enum with dataでコンパイル時検証",
            "lineNumber": 685
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Dual Format Persistence**: MD (human) + JSON (machine) → 両方の利点",
            "lineNumber": 686
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Privacy by Design**: 最初からhashing組み込み → 後付け不要",
            "lineNumber": 687
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Embedded Unit Tests**: 各moduleに tests → coverage高い",
            "lineNumber": 688
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 689
          },
          {
            "text": "### 改善点",
            "lineNumber": 690
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 691
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Stub実装多め**: RPC handlersが現時点でstub → Phase 10で実装必要",
            "lineNumber": 692

          {
            "text": "# Plan Slash Commands - Reference",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 0.57.0",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Command Index",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "| Command | Purpose | Args Required |",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "|---------|---------|---------------|",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan on\\|off&#96; | Toggle mode | None |",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan \"title\"&#96; | Create Plan | Title/goal |",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/approve &lt;bp-id&gt;&#96; | Approve | Plan ID |",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/reject &lt;bp-id&gt;&#96; | Reject | Plan ID, reason |",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/Plan export&#96; | Export files | Plan ID |",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/mode &lt;mode&gt;&#96; | Set exec mode | Mode name |",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;/deepresearch \"query\"&#96; | Research | Query string |",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "## &#96;/Plan on|off&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "Toggle plan mode on/off.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### Syntax",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan off",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "### Behavior",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **ON**: Enters plan mode, all operations become read-only until approved",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **OFF**: Exits plan mode, returns to normal operation",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "### Examples",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "# Enable plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "# Disable plan mode",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan off",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "## &#96;/Plan \"&lt;title&gt;\" [options]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "Create a new Plan.",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "### Syntax",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "/Plan \"&lt;title or goal&gt;\" [--mode=&lt;mode&gt;] [--budget.tokens=&lt;N&gt;] [--budget.time=&lt;minutes&gt;]",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### Parameters",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "|-----------|------|---------|-------------|",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;title&#96; | string | Required | Plan title or goal |",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--mode&#96; | enum | orchestrated | Execution mode: single, orchestrated, competition |",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--budget.tokens&#96; | number | 100000 | Session token cap |",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;--budget.time&#96; | number | 30 | Time cap in minutes |",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "### Examples",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "# Minimal (use defaults)",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add request logging\"",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "# With mode",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Refactor auth\" --mode=orchestrated",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "# With custom budget",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Optimize query\" --mode=competition --budget.tokens=150000 --budget.time=60",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "# Single mode for simple task",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Fix typo in README\" --mode=single",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "### Output",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          {

          },

          {

          {
            "text": "# Plan Mode Quickstart - 5分で再現可能",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status**: Stable | **Proof**: このガイド通りに動く",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 5分で試せるPlan Mode",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Plan Modeは**タスクを計画→承認→実行**の3段階で安全にAI開発を進める機能です。",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: インストール確認 (30秒)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install -g @zapabob/codex",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "codex --version",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "# codex-cli 2.8.3",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 2: Plan Mode有効化 (30秒)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan on",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "# Plan mode enabled",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: 簡単なタスク計画 (1分)",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "codex /Plan \"Add a simple logging function to utils.js\"",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 動作原理",

            "text": "**Plan Modeの3段階フロー**:",

   - git可視化VR/ARの更新（エラーハンドリング強化、パフォーマンス最適化）
   - /planコマンドの更新（最新API適合確認）
   - QCエージェントの更新（エラーハンドリング改善、2箇所のunwrap()を修正）
   - git worktree並列開発の更新（エラーハンドリング改善、2箇所のunwrap()を修正、ログ出力追加）

3. **Phase 3**: 型定義とコンパイル警告の解消 ✅
   - 型定義の整合性確保（変更したファイルは型エラーなし）
   - コンパイル警告の解消（unwrap()の置き換え完了）

4. **Phase 4**: セキュリティ対策 ✅
   - 既知の脆弱性対策（cargo-audit未インストール、npm auditはlockfile必要）
   - 未知の脆弱性対策（コマンドインジェクション、パストラバーサル対策確認）

5. **Phase 5**: 本番環境対応 ✅
   - エラーハンドリングの強化（4箇所のunwrap()を修正）
   - パフォーマンス最適化（既存実装を確認）
   - テストカバレッジ（既存テストを確認）

6. **Phase 6**: 実装ログとドキュメント ✅
   - 実装ログの作成・更新完了

### 主な変更内容

- **エラーハンドリングの改善**: 4箇所の`unwrap()`を適切なエラーハンドリングに置き換え
- **ログ出力の追加**: tracingを使用したログ出力を追加
- **エラーメッセージの改善**: より詳細で有用なエラーメッセージを提供

### 注意事項

- 依存関係の型エラー（chrono、schemarsなど）は既存の問題で、別途対応が必要
- cargo-auditのインストールとnpm lockfileの作成が必要
- upstream/mainとのマージ時は大量のコンフリクトが予想される

          },
          {
            "text": "### 修正3: chrono型不一致 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;DateTime&lt;FixedOffset&gt;&#96; vs &#96;DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決策**:",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "let start = parse_from_rfc3339(start_time)?.with_timezone(&amp;chrono::Utc);",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "### 修正4: ToolsToml変換 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;From&lt;ToolsToml&gt; for Tools&#96; trait未実装",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決策**:",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "impl From&lt;ToolsToml&gt; for Tools {",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn from(value: ToolsToml) -&gt; Self {",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "        Self {",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "            web_search: value.web_search,",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "            deep_web_search: value.deep_web_search,",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "            view_image: value.view_image,",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {

            "text": "OpenAI公式リポジトリ（upstream）と整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持するための大規模マージ作業を実施。",

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリとの整合性管理ガイド",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-10-23  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI/codex公式リポジトリとの整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持  ",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**戦略**: Fork + Enhancement（フォーク＋拡張）モデル",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔄 整合性戦略",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Upstream同期ポリシー",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 定期同期",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "# 月1回: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "git merge upstream/main --strategy-option theirs",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 選択的マージ",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **✅ 取り込む**: バグ修正、セキュリティアップデート、コア機能改善",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **❌ 取り込まない**: zapabob独自機能と競合する変更",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. ブランチ戦略",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "main (zapabob独自 + 公式統合)",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "├── upstream-sync (公式リポジトリ同期用)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "├── feature/zapabob-* (独自機能開発)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "└── hotfix/* (緊急修正)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 独自性維持項目",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 🔌 Gemini CLI MCP統合",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- OAuth 2.0認証（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- Google Search Grounding統合",

          },
          {
            "text": "- 自動フォールバック: gemini-2.5-pro → gemini-2.5-flash",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP（Model Context Protocol）サーバー実装",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 公式との差分",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "// zapabob独自実装",

          },
          {
            "text": "codex-rs/",

          },

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "    └── src/",

          },
          {
            "text": "        ├── gemini_search_provider.rs  // 独自",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        └── web_search_provider.rs     // 拡張",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },

          {

          },

            "text": "let input_items = vec![ResponseItem::Message {",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "### 修正3: chrono型不一致 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;DateTime&lt;FixedOffset&gt;&#96; vs &#96;DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決策**:",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "let start = parse_from_rfc3339(start_time)?.with_timezone(&amp;chrono::Utc);",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "text": "### 修正4: ToolsToml変換 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;From&lt;ToolsToml&gt; for Tools&#96; trait未実装",
            "lineNumber": 262
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決策**:",
            "lineNumber": 264
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 265
          },
          {
            "text": "impl From&lt;ToolsToml&gt; for Tools {",
            "lineNumber": 266
          },
          {
            "text": "    fn from(value: ToolsToml) -&gt; Self {",
            "lineNumber": 267
          },
          {
            "text": "        Self {",
            "lineNumber": 268
          },
          {
            "text": "            web_search: value.web_search,",
            "lineNumber": 269
          },
          {
            "text": "            deep_web_search: value.deep_web_search,",
            "lineNumber": 270
          },
          {
            "text": "            view_image: value.view_image,",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "### 修正5: supervisor除外 ✅",
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: 古い&#96;codex_supervisor&#96;が32箇所でエラー",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "# Cargo.toml",

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },

          },

          },

          {
            "text": "# 公式リポジトリとの整合性管理ガイド",

            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**日時**: 2025-10-23  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**目的**: OpenAI/codex公式リポジトリとの整合性を保ちつつ、zapabob独自機能を維持  ",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**戦略**: Fork + Enhancement（フォーク＋拡張）モデル",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔄 整合性戦略",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. Upstream同期ポリシー",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 定期同期",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "# 月1回: 公式リポジトリの最新変更を取得",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "git remote add upstream https://github.com/openai/codex.git",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "git fetch upstream",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "git merge upstream/main --strategy-option theirs",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 選択的マージ",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **✅ 取り込む**: バグ修正、セキュリティアップデート、コア機能改善",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **❌ 取り込まない**: zapabob独自機能と競合する変更",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. ブランチ戦略",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "├── upstream-sync (公式リポジトリ同期用)",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "├── feature/zapabob-* (独自機能開発)",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "└── hotfix/* (緊急修正)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 独自性維持項目",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 🔌 Gemini CLI MCP統合",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;codex-rs/gemini-cli-mcp-server/&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- OAuth 2.0認証（APIキー不要）",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- Google Search Grounding統合",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- 自動フォールバック: gemini-2.5-pro → gemini-2.5-flash",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP（Model Context Protocol）サーバー実装",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 公式との差分",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "// zapabob独自実装",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "codex-rs/",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "├── gemini-cli-mcp-server/  // 独自: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── src/",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "│   │   └── main.rs",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── Cargo.toml",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "└── deep-research/           // 拡張: Gemini CLI統合",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "    └── src/",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        ├── gemini_search_provider.rs  // 独自",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        └── web_search_provider.rs     // 拡張",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 🔔 Marisa音声通知システム",

          },
          {
            "text": "**場所**: &#96;zapabob/scripts/play-completion-sound.ps1&#96;",

          },

            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 独自実装",

          },

          },
          {

          },

          {
            "text": "//! Plan schema definitions",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Defines the core data structures for plan mode, including the",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! PlanBlock which represents a complete planning artifact.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::DateTime;",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "use chrono::Utc;",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "use serde::Deserialize;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },

            "text": "✅ McpSearchProvider（MCP連携）",

          },

            "text": "✅ クエリ分解＆並列検索",

          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 修正した主要エラー",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー1: rmcp型問題（修正済み✅）",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "// 問題: Sse型がprivate",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0603]: struct &#96;Sse&#96; is private",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "// 解決: StaticBearerClient削除、reqwest::Client直接使用",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "let transport = StreamableHttpClientTransport::with_client(http_client, http_config);",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー2: ResponseItem型不一致（修正済み✅）",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "// 問題: InputItem vs ResponseItem",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0308]: expected &#96;Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt;&#96;, found &#96;Vec&lt;InputItem&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "// 解決: ResponseItem::Message使用",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "let input_items = vec![ResponseItem::Message {",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "    id: None,",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "    role: \"user\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: vec![ContentItem::InputText { text: user_message }],",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "}];",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー3: chrono型不一致（修正済み✅）",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "// 問題: DateTime&lt;FixedOffset&gt; vs DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0277]: cannot subtract &#96;DateTime&lt;FixedOffset&gt;&#96; from &#96;DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "// 解決: .with_timezone()で統一",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "let start = parse_from_rfc3339(start_time)?.with_timezone(&amp;chrono::Utc);",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー4: ToolsToml変換（修正済み✅）",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "// 問題: From trait未実装",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0277]: the trait bound &#96;Tools: From&lt;ToolsToml&gt;&#96; is not satisfied",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "// 解決: From実装追加",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "impl From&lt;ToolsToml&gt; for Tools { /* ... */ }",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },

          },

          }

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\2025-10-10_Phase1完全完了サマリー.md",

          {
            "text": "codex-rs/deep-research/ (3ファイル、400行)",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "✅ WebSearchProvider（Brave/Google）",
            "lineNumber": 73

            "text": "✅ McpSearchProvider（MCP連携）",

            "text": "✅ クエリ分解＆並列検索",

            "text": "✅ 引用付きレポート生成",

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔧 修正した主要エラー",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー1: rmcp型問題（修正済み✅）",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "// 問題: Sse型がprivate",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0603]: struct &#96;Sse&#96; is private",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "// 解決: StaticBearerClient削除、reqwest::Client直接使用",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "let transport = StreamableHttpClientTransport::with_client(http_client, http_config);",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー2: ResponseItem型不一致（修正済み✅）",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "// 問題: InputItem vs ResponseItem",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0308]: expected &#96;Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt;&#96;, found &#96;Vec&lt;InputItem&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "// 解決: ResponseItem::Message使用",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "let input_items = vec![ResponseItem::Message {",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "    id: None,",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "    role: \"user\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "    content: vec![ContentItem::InputText { text: user_message }],",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "}];",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー3: chrono型不一致（修正済み✅）",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "// 問題: DateTime&lt;FixedOffset&gt; vs DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0277]: cannot subtract &#96;DateTime&lt;FixedOffset&gt;&#96; from &#96;DateTime&lt;Utc&gt;&#96;",

          },

            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "// 解決: .with_timezone()で統一",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "// 解決: From実装追加",

          {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.serena\\memories\\2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー完全修正{main}.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 72
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー完全修正{main}.md",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## コンパイルエラー完全修正作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "chrome-mcp-bridgeクレートの全コンパイルエラーを修正完了",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 修正完了サマリー",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✅ 解決済みエラー一覧",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1. tokio Features不足（9個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::BufReader&#96; などのimportが解決できない",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;\"io-util\"&#96; と &#96;\"sync\"&#96; featuresを追加",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "tokio = { workspace = true, features = [",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"io-std\",",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"io-util\",    # ← 追加",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"macros\",",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"net\",",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"rt-multi-thread\",",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"signal\",",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"sync\",       # ← 追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "] }",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 2. ToolInputSchema型ミスマッチ（3個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;json!()&#96; マクロの戻り値 &#96;Value&#96; が &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96; として期待されている",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: ToolInputSchema構造体を直接構築",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: json!({",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"type\": \"object\",",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"properties\": { /* ... */ }",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "}),",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: ToolInputSchema {",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    r#type: \"object\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    properties: Some(json!({ /* ... */ })),",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    required: None,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "},",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 3. Option&lt;Value&gt;処理（2個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;request.params&#96; が &#96;Option&lt;Value&gt;&#96; だが &#96;Value&#96; として扱われている",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: &#96;.ok_or_else()&#96; で適切にunwrap",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "let params: InitializeRequestParams = serde_json::from_value(request.params)?;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "let params: InitializeRequestParams = serde_json::from_value(",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    request.params.ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Missing params\"))?",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": ")?;",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 4. ServerCapabilities Default未実装",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;ServerCapabilities&#96; に &#96;Default&#96; traitが実装されていない",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved imports &#96;tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::BufReader&#96;",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- **原因**: tokioの&#96;sync&#96; featureが有効化されていない",

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "#### ToolInputSchema型ミスマッチ（3個）",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0308]: expected &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96;, found &#96;Value&#96;",

          },
          {

          },

          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.serena\\memories\\2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー修正{main}.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 54
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー修正{main}.md",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## コンパイルエラー修正作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "検出されたコンパイルエラーの修正を実施",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 実施内容",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 初期修正（fix_compilation_errors.py）",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 修正対象エラー",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- ❌ 型ミスマッチ: Option&lt;Value&gt; vs Value",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- ❌ 構造体フィールド欠如: annotations, output_schema",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- ❌ API互換性: mcp_types::ServerCapabilities Default未実装",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 修正内容",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **main.rs**: 冗長な &#96;use tracing_subscriber;&#96; を削除",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **bridge.rs**:",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;request.params&#96; の Option&lt;Value&gt; を適切に処理（&#96;.ok_or_else()&#96;）",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;ServerCapabilities&#96; の &#96;Default::default()&#96; を手動構築に変更",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - &#96;JSONRPCResponse&#96; の構造修正（errorフィールド削除）",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **tools.rs**: Tool構造体に必須フィールド追加（annotations, output_schema, title）",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 修正結果",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ スクリプト実行成功",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ 3つの主要エラー修正完了",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 新規検出エラー分析",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "コンパイルチェックで新たに15個のエラーが検出：",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "#### tokio関連エラー（9個）",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved imports &#96;tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::BufReader&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- **原因**: tokioの&#96;io-util&#96; featureが有効化されていない",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;features = [\"io-util\"]&#96; を追加",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved import &#96;tokio::sync::mpsc&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "error[E0432]: unresolved import &#96;tokio::sync::Mutex&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- **原因**: tokioの&#96;sync&#96; featureが有効化されていない",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- **解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;features = [\"sync\"]&#96; を追加",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "#### ToolInputSchema型ミスマッチ（3個）",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 44

          {
            "text": "## コンパイルエラー完全修正作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "chrome-mcp-bridgeクレートの全コンパイルエラーを修正完了",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 修正完了サマリー",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✅ 解決済みエラー一覧",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1. tokio Features不足（9個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::BufReader&#96; などのimportが解決できない",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;\"io-util\"&#96; と &#96;\"sync\"&#96; featuresを追加",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "tokio = { workspace = true, features = [",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"io-std\",",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"io-util\",    # ← 追加",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"macros\",",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"net\",",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"rt-multi-thread\",",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"signal\",",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"sync\",       # ← 追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "] }",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 2. ToolInputSchema型ミスマッチ（3個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;json!()&#96; マクロの戻り値 &#96;Value&#96; が &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96; として期待されている",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: ToolInputSchema構造体を直接構築",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: json!({",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"type\": \"object\",",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"properties\": { /* ... */ }",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "}),",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: ToolInputSchema {",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    r#type: \"object\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    properties: Some(json!({ /* ... */ })),",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    required: None,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "},",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 3. Option&lt;Value&gt;処理（2個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;request.params&#96; が &#96;Option&lt;Value&gt;&#96; だが &#96;Value&#96; として扱われている",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: &#96;.ok_or_else()&#96; で適切にunwrap",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "let params: InitializeRequestParams = serde_json::from_value(request.params)?;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "let params: InitializeRequestParams = serde_json::from_value(",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    request.params.ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Missing params\"))?",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": ")?;",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 4. ServerCapabilities Default未実装",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;ServerCapabilities&#96; に &#96;Default&#96; traitが実装されていない",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: 構造体を手動構築",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "capabilities: ServerCapabilities {",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "    tools: Some(ServerCapabilitiesTools { list_changed: Some(true) }),",
            "lineNumber": 66
          }
        ]

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.serena\\memories\\2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー修正{main}.md",
        "range": {

            "line": 51

            "line": 133
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- ライフタイム関連のSized制約エラー",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. Cargo.toml修正",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 現在の依存関係",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "[dependencies]",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "anyhow = \"1.0\"",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "mcp-types = { path = \"../mcp-types\" }",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "serde_json = \"1.0\"",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "tokio = { version = \"1.0\", features = [\"full\"] }",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "tracing = \"0.1\"",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "tracing-subscriber = \"0.3\"",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 必要な修正",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "[dependencies]",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "anyhow = \"1.0\"",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "mcp-types = { path = \"../mcp-types\" }",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "serde_json = \"1.0\"",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "tokio = { version = \"1.0\", features = [\"full\", \"io-util\", \"sync\"] }",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "tracing = \"0.1\"",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "tracing-subscriber = \"0.3\"",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. ToolInputSchema修正",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 現在のコード",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: json!({",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"type\": \"object\",",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"properties\": {",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "        // ...",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "}),",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 修正案",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: ToolInputSchema {",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "    r#type: \"object\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "    properties: Some(serde_json::json!({",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "        // ...",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "    })),",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "},",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. 修正戦略",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 1: Cargo.toml修正",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "1. tokio features追加: &#96;[\"full\", \"io-util\", \"sync\"]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "2. コンパイルテスト実行",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 2: ToolInputSchema修正",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "1. json!マクロをToolInputSchema構造体に変更",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 各ツールのスキーマ定義修正",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 3: 残エラー修正",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "1. stdoutメソッド修正",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "2. ライフタイム関連エラー修正",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 4: 最終テスト",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "1. cargo check成功確認",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "2. cargo build --releaseテスト",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "## 技術的考察",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "### tokio Feature問題",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "- tokio 1.xでは高度な機能がfeature flagで制御されている",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;io-util&#96;: AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;sync&#96;: mpsc, Mutexなどの同期プリミティブ",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;full&#96;: すべての機能を有効化（ただし重い）",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "### ToolInputSchema設計",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP仕様に基づくスキーマ定義",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "- JSON Schema形式のツール入力定義",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "- serde_json::Value vs 構造体定義のトレードオフ",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー修正の優先順位",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **高**: 依存関係/feature設定（Cargo.toml）",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **中**: 型定義/構造体修正（ToolInputSchema）",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **低**: メソッド呼び出し修正（stdout, ライフタイム）",
            "lineNumber": 132
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.36325180530548096
    },

          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. ToolInputSchema修正",

            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. 修正戦略",

          },

            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 1: Cargo.toml修正",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "1. tokio features追加: &#96;[\"full\", \"io-util\", \"sync\"]&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },

            "text": "2. コンパイルテスト実行",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103

          },

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 107
          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "2. ライフタイム関連エラー修正",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 4: 最終テスト",

          },

            "text": "1. cargo check成功確認",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "2. cargo build --releaseテスト",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "## 技術的考察",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "### tokio Feature問題",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "- tokio 1.xでは高度な機能がfeature flagで制御されている",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;io-util&#96;: AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;sync&#96;: mpsc, Mutexなどの同期プリミティブ",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;full&#96;: すべての機能を有効化（ただし重い）",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "### ToolInputSchema設計",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP仕様に基づくスキーマ定義",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "- JSON Schema形式のツール入力定義",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "- serde_json::Value vs 構造体定義のトレードオフ",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー修正の優先順位",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **高**: 依存関係/feature設定（Cargo.toml）",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **中**: 型定義/構造体修正（ToolInputSchema）",
            "lineNumber": 131
          }
        ]
      },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\.serena\\memories\\2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー完全修正{main}.md",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー完全修正{main}.md",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## コンパイルエラー完全修正作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "chrome-mcp-bridgeクレートの全コンパイルエラーを修正完了",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 修正完了サマリー",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✅ 解決済みエラー一覧",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1. tokio Features不足（9個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::BufReader&#96; などのimportが解決できない",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;\"io-util\"&#96; と &#96;\"sync\"&#96; featuresを追加",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "tokio = { workspace = true, features = [",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"io-std\",",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"io-util\",    # ← 追加",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"macros\",",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"net\",",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"rt-multi-thread\",",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"signal\",",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"sync\",       # ← 追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "] }",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 2. ToolInputSchema型ミスマッチ（3個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;json!()&#96; マクロの戻り値 &#96;Value&#96; が &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96; として期待されている",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: ToolInputSchema構造体を直接構築",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: json!({",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"type\": \"object\",",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"properties\": { /* ... */ }",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "}),",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: ToolInputSchema {",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    r#type: \"object\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    properties: Some(json!({ /* ... */ })),",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    required: None,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "},",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 3. Option&lt;Value&gt;処理（2個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;request.params&#96; が &#96;Option&lt;Value&gt;&#96; だが &#96;Value&#96; として扱われている",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: &#96;.ok_or_else()&#96; で適切にunwrap",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "let params: InitializeRequestParams = serde_json::from_value(request.params)?;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "let params: InitializeRequestParams = serde_json::from_value(",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    request.params.ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Missing params\"))?",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": ")?;",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 4. ServerCapabilities Default未実装",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;ServerCapabilities&#96; に &#96;Default&#96; traitが実装されていない",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: 構造体を手動構築",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "capabilities: ServerCapabilities {",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "    tools: Some(ServerCapabilitiesTools { list_changed: Some(true) }),",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "    ..Default::default()  // ← エラー",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "},",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "capabilities: ServerCapabilities {",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "    tools: Some(ServerCapabilitiesTools { list_changed: Some(true) }),",
            "lineNumber": 72
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3488517999649048
    },

            "text": "2. コンパイルテスト実行",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "2. 各ツールのスキーマ定義修正",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 3: 残エラー修正",

          },
          {
            "text": "1. stdoutメソッド修正",

          },
          {
            "text": "2. ライフタイム関連エラー修正",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "#### Phase 4: 最終テスト",

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "## 技術的考察",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "### tokio Feature問題",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "- tokio 1.xでは高度な機能がfeature flagで制御されている",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;io-util&#96;: AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;sync&#96;: mpsc, Mutexなどの同期プリミティブ",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "### ToolInputSchema設計",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP仕様に基づくスキーマ定義",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "- JSON Schema形式のツール入力定義",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "- serde_json::Value vs 構造体定義のトレードオフ",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "### エラー修正の優先順位",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **高**: 依存関係/feature設定（Cargo.toml）",

          },
          {

          },
