        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 2026-01-02_コンパイルエラー完全修正{main}.md",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## コンパイルエラー完全修正作業概要",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "chrome-mcp-bridgeクレートの全コンパイルエラーを修正完了",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 修正完了サマリー",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✅ 解決済みエラー一覧",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1. tokio Features不足（9個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;tokio::io::AsyncBufReadExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::AsyncWriteExt&#96;, &#96;tokio::io::BufReader&#96; などのimportが解決できない",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: Cargo.tomlに &#96;\"io-util\"&#96; と &#96;\"sync\"&#96; featuresを追加",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "tokio = { workspace = true, features = [",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"io-std\",",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"io-util\",    # ← 追加",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"macros\",",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"net\",",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"rt-multi-thread\",",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"signal\",",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"sync\",       # ← 追加",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "] }",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 2. ToolInputSchema型ミスマッチ（3個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;json!()&#96; マクロの戻り値 &#96;Value&#96; が &#96;ToolInputSchema&#96; として期待されている",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: ToolInputSchema構造体を直接構築",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: json!({",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"type\": \"object\",",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"properties\": { /* ... */ }",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "}),",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "input_schema: ToolInputSchema {",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "    r#type: \"object\".to_string(),",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    properties: Some(json!({ /* ... */ })),",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "    required: None,",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "},",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 3. Option&lt;Value&gt;処理（2個のエラー）",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;request.params&#96; が &#96;Option&lt;Value&gt;&#96; だが &#96;Value&#96; として扱われている",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: &#96;.ok_or_else()&#96; で適切にunwrap",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "let params: InitializeRequestParams = serde_json::from_value(request.params)?;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正後",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "let params: InitializeRequestParams = serde_json::from_value(",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    request.params.ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"Missing params\"))?",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": ")?;",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 4. ServerCapabilities Default未実装",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "**問題**: &#96;ServerCapabilities&#96; に &#96;Default&#96; traitが実装されていない",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "**解決**: 構造体を手動構築",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;rust",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "// 修正前",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "capabilities: ServerCapabilities {",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "    tools: Some(ServerCapabilitiesTools { list_changed: Some(true) }),",
            "lineNumber": 66
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3460678458213806
    },

The guide can be found at the project's UPGRADE.md file on GitHub.<br/><br/>## Release Status<br/><br/>Version 5.0.0 was officially released on January 21, 2025[4], after progressing through alpha and release candidate versions. The stable release followed multiple pre-release versions starting with 5.0.0-alpha.1 in February 2024[4]. |

          {
            "text": "//! This file handles all logic related to managing MCP OAuth credentials.",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//! All credentials are stored using the keyring crate which uses os-specific keyring services.",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! https://crates.io/crates/keyring",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! macOS: macOS keychain.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Windows: Windows Credential Manager",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Linux: DBus-based Secret Service, the kernel keyutils, and a combo of the two",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! FreeBSD, OpenBSD: DBus-based Secret Service",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! For Linux, we use linux-native-async-persistent which uses both keyutils and async-secret-service (see below) for storage.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! See the docs for the keyutils_persistent module for a full explanation of why both are used. Because this store uses the",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//! async-secret-service, you must specify the additional features required by that store",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//! async-secret-service provides access to the DBus-based Secret Service storage on Linux, FreeBSD, and OpenBSD. This is an asynchronous",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! keystore that always encrypts secrets when they are transferred across the bus. If DBus isn't installed the keystore will fall back to the json",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! file because we don't use the \"vendored\" feature.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! If the keyring is not available or fails, we fall back to CODEX_HOME/.credentials.json which is consistent with other coding CLI agents.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
